justification: User-facing brief truth fix: the ANEF field sourced parcel-level values from the coarse anef_zones digitisations (13-vertex polygons, ANEF-20 ~789 km2) which stamped false contour values on fringe lots. Value path narrowed to the live LEP/SEPP-mapped government layer. No DB writes, no new sources, no frontend type changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: anef_zones measured 2026-07-06: 10-13 vertices per contour, ANEF-20 polygon ~789 km2 (published ANEF 2039 contour is a fraction); live ePlanning Protection ANEF layer holds 29 LEP/SEPP-mapped features (Liverpool, Upper Hunter, WSA precincts; no Sydney KSA). Conveyancing PDF already quarantined in PR #681 with the same evidence.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If anef_zones is later re-digitised properly, re-enabling it is a one-line resolver change plus removing the quarantine guard tests; until then Sydney lots render the honest scoped claim 'No ANEF contour in the mapped planning layers' instead of a fabricated value.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new sources: the field builder now uses ONLY the existing portal_constraints.fetch_anef live query; fetch_anef_zone stays as the documented quarantined accessor (verify-app parity) with its contract unchanged so existing harness stubs keep working.

functions.name: _anef_fields
functions.input: covered layers, overlay anef value, lat/lng from the geocoded brief address
functions.output: display DataField plus numeric anef_level DataField from one live-layer lookup
functions.if_none: live lookup failure returns NOT_AVAILABLE with reason, never a checked-none claim; genuine none renders the scoped 'mapped planning layers' wording

functions.name: fetch_anef_zone
functions.input: latitude and longitude for the curated anef_zones table
functions.output: level, airport and version dict or None — QUARANTINED, no brief or PDF surface calls it
functions.if_none: returns None on failure (fail-open contract preserved for the verify-app parity and future re-digitised data)

values.value: regional.anef_code / anef_level from the live Protection layer
values.nullable: yes — band code may be absent, level may be unparseable
values.guard_at: services/intelligence_brief.py:2873 (_parse_anef_number returns None on non-numeric, never a guess)
values.if_missing: display falls back to whichever field exists; numeric field stays None at authoritative confidence

queries: N/A — no SQL changed; the quarantined anef_zones query is untouched and uncalled by this surface

break_it.scenario: Someone re-adds the anef_zones step to the brief's ANEF field
break_it.what_happens: Coarse 13-vertex polygons would again stamp false contour values on fringe lots (Pymble rendered ANEF 20 pre-quarantine)
break_it.how: guard tests monkeypatch fetch_anef_zone to raise AssertionError if consulted (both test files)
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_overlay_live_fallback.py -k never_consulted; python -m pytest tests/test_brief_slice2_distances.py -k quarantined

break_it.scenario: Live layer lookup fails and the field claims no contour applies
break_it.what_happens: A checked-none claim off a failed check — the WO-2 silent-false-negative class
break_it.how: failure branch returns NOT_AVAILABLE with 'did not complete' reason; existing test_anef_lookup_failures_are_not_available_not_no_contour still passes

break_it.scenario: The honest-empty wording overclaims coverage (says 'no published contour' when Sydney KSA contours exist but are not machine-readable)
break_it.what_happens: A Mascot brief would falsely assert no published contour exists at a genuinely noise-affected lot
break_it.how: wording changed to 'No ANEF contour in the mapped planning layers at this property' — scoped to exactly what was checked

break_it.scenario: Covered-but-empty ingested overlay short-circuits to a blank instead of checking the live layer
break_it.what_happens: Lots in covered LGAs would silently lose their live-layer contour value
break_it.how: fall-through order preserved: overlay-with-value wins, else live layer, else honest empty/failure

post_merge.manual_verify: No — behaviour pinned by guard + wording tests; the verify app's /api/environmental/anef route still reads anef_zones (orphan endpoint, no in-repo consumers) — tracked in issue #686
